race.title: Follow Matchbook On X Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: SENATOR was well on top at the finish when making a winning chase bow/return at Stratford 3 weeks ago so he's taken to defy a 7 lb rise. This does look competitive, though, with Moyganny Phil and Parliamo heading the dangers. SENATOR (FR) MOYGANNY PHIL (IRE) PARLIAMO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Senator (9/4), Duffry Trixs (9/2), Valadon (9/2), Parliamo (5/1), Moyganny Phil (7/1), Shabalko D'herm (8/1), Timmys Jet Away (12/1)
